title: PongLens
tagline: Film the match once, and study it all year.

lines.text: PongLens turns the matches you film into a point-by-point record of your game, that you can score, study, analyze, and review with your coach.

lines.label: Bring a match in
lines.text: Upload the match you filmed on your phone, and say who you played. It lands in your library, and you choose when to turn it into points.

lines.label: Bring a match in
lines.text: It comes back as pure table tennis. The dead time between points is removed, and what is left is every point you played.

lines.label: Watch it back
lines.text: Playback is built for studying. Hold one side of the screen for double speed, or the other for quarter speed, and zoom in when you want to watch a single shot.

lines.label: Watch it back
lines.text: You can replay the point you are on, or jump straight to any other point in the match.

lines.label: Watch it back
lines.text: And you can stop on a frame to write a note on that point or draw on it, without leaving the video.

lines.label: Score it
lines.text: Score Keeper plays the points one after another, and you tap who won each one. The score, the game count and the serve rotation keep themselves up to date, so a full match takes under ten minutes.

lines.label: Score it
lines.text: And every point you score becomes the data your analysis is built on.

lines.label: Read the match
lines.text: A scored match can answer real questions you didn't know before, like how many points you win off serve receive, and how you perform during high pressure points.

lines.label: Read the match
lines.text: Keep scoring, and the same picture builds over time.

lines.label: Read the match
lines.text: Placement maps show what your opponent kept doing to you, and what kept working for you.

lines.label: Work with a coach
lines.text: And your coach can review the real match from anywhere. They can drop a written comment, draw on the frame, or leave a voice note on that exact point.

lines.label: Work with a coach
lines.text: Or get your match professionally reviewed, with what is costing you points and the exact points to watch.

lines.label: One journal
lines.text: Lessons, notes, even pages from your notebook end up in one searchable journal.

lines.label: One journal
lines.text: You can also ask your journal a question, and it answers from what you have written.

lines.label: One journal
lines.text: And Recollect turns your lessons into practice cards, so the coaching sticks.

lines.label: Share it
lines.text: When a rally deserves an audience, export one point or the whole match for social media,

lines.label: Share it
lines.text: with the score burned into the picture, so it reads like a real match wherever you post it.

lines.label: Share it
lines.text: Or share the same points as a link, so friends and family can watch the highlights.
Your match already contains a record of how you play. PongLens makes that record useful. Upload your first match today.
PongLens. Film the match once, and study it all year.
